data.title: Loading Dock Challenge!
data.description: Find the steepest whole-degree ramp that your fixed force budget can handle to help load the cargo.

challenges.title: Loading Dock Limit
challenges.brief: Build the steepest whole-degree ramp this push budget can handle. The dock height must stay fixed.
challenges.hint: If the load cannot climb, make the ramp gentler. If it can, see whether one more degree still works.
challenges.explainOnSolve: You found the boundary design: any steeper would exceed the force budget, while any gentler would use more ramp length than necessary.

challenges.title: Smooth Access Ramp
challenges.brief: Use the available push to make the steepest workable ramp to the fixed platform.
challenges.hint: Search for the boundary between works and does not work, then choose the steepest working angle.
challenges.explainOnSolve: The design balances two constraints: enough push to climb and no extra ramp length beyond what the budget requires.

challenges.title: Rough-Site Ramp
challenges.brief: The site surface is rough. Find the steepest ramp that still reaches the platform within the force budget.
challenges.hint: Roughness uses part of the force budget before the load even fights the slope.
challenges.explainOnSolve: Because friction consumed more of the budget, this design needed a gentler, longer ramp.

challenges.title: Barrel Delivery Route
challenges.brief: Choose the steepest whole-degree route the crew can use without exceeding its push limit.
challenges.hint: Try a working angle, then increase one degree at a time until the next step fails.
challenges.explainOnSolve: The last working angle is the efficient boundary: it reaches the same height with the shortest feasible ramp.
